handoff_metadata.title: Polarix Unified ML Handoff Contract
handoff_metadata.synthetic_disclaimer: Synthetic telemetry only. Evaluated and benchmarked strictly on synthetic Antarctic telemetry datasets. Not certified for real Antarctic operational deployment without field data recalibration.

Core ML inference service adapters (MaitriMLService, BharatiMLService)
Typed telemetry schemas (TelemetryInput, TelemetryInferenceOutput, BharatiTelemetryInput, BharatiTelemetryOutput)
Inference observability and diagnostic audit logging

station_id.description: Station identifier ('MTR' for Maitri, 'BRT' for Bharati).

sensor_id.description: Sensor identifier matching supported station sensors.

value.description: Numerical measurement. Null, NaN, or Inf triggers MISSING_DATA.

anomaly_score.description: Mean squared error reconstruction loss. Null for INSUFFICIENT_DATA and MISSING_DATA.

anomaly_type.description: Physical anomaly classification. Null for INSUFFICIENT_DATA and MISSING_DATA.

status_semantics.NORMAL: Observation sequence evaluated with reconstruction loss <= threshold. No anomaly detected.
status_semantics.ANOMALY: Observation sequence evaluated with reconstruction loss > threshold. Anomaly detected.
status_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Sensor sliding window buffer has fewer than 30 observations. Model inference is bypassed.
status_semantics.MISSING_DATA: Telemetry is null, NaN/Inf, or has non-GOOD quality. Buffer is reset and inference is bypassed.

anomaly_type_semantics.NORMAL: Sequence pattern conforms to expected baseline behavior.
anomaly_type_semantics.SPIKE: Sudden sharp single-step or short-duration amplitude jump.
anomaly_type_semantics.DRIFT: Sustained directional trend or monotonic ramp divergence.
anomaly_type_semantics.STUCK_VALUE: Zero or near-zero variance flatline condition over consecutive observations.
anomaly_type_semantics.UNKNOWN: Reconstruction error exceeds threshold but pattern does not match standard heuristic templates.

error_categories.DuplicateTelemetryError: Identical timestamp submitted repeatedly for the same sensor.
error_categories.StaleTelemetryError: Out-of-order timestamp earlier than previously recorded observation.
error_categories.UnsupportedStationError: Station ID not recognized in supported station registry.
error_categories.UnsupportedSensorError: Sensor ID not recognized in supported sensor registry.
error_categories.InvalidContractError: Payload fails schema validation, required fields missing, or invalid types.

state_management.isolation: Independent rolling deque per sensor (no cross-sensor state sharing).
state_management.volatility: In-memory state resets to empty upon process restart.
state_management.dropout_behavior: Missing or bad quality telemetry immediately flushes the sensor buffer to 0.
